We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Job Title: HR Operations SpecialistÂ 

Type: Independent ContractorÂ 

Location: Remote | South Africa

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respectâcreating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Support the employee onboarding process, helping new hires get set up and proficient with the firm's technology stack within their first week.
  • Assist with HR document, process, and compliance audits, and monitor completion of required documentation, certifications, training, and policy acknowledgements.
  • Follow up with employees and managers on outstanding compliance items.
  • Maintain accurate HR records within Rippling and other HR systems.

Recruitment & Talent Support

  • Support sourcing for open roles, including candidate outreach and headhunting for hard-to-fill positions when standard applicant pipelines fall short.
  • Help manage candidate pipelines and keep hiring managers updated on status.
  • Assist with background and reference checks and credential verification.
  • Participate in candidate interviews alongside hiring managers.

Training & Development

  • Help maintain and update the firm's training curriculum, onboarding materials, and learning resources.
  • Assist in creating SOPs, workflow documentation, process maps, and training materials as needed.
  • Support the development of assessments and knowledge checks to track training completion.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
  • Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and platforms (required).
  • Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
  • Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HR operations for a U.S.-based company, including onboarding, compliance, or employee lifecycle support (required).
  • Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
  • Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Preferred: recruitment or sourcing experience, including candidate outreach, vetting, and interviewing.
  • Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.
  • Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
  • Paid time off, including U.S. federal holidays, sick leave, and annual leave.
  • Pacific Time-aligned working hours with reasonable flexibility.
  • Opportunity to grow with the firm's HR function as it scales.
  • Structured onboarding and clear expectations from day one.
  • Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. law firm.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment built on accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Thoughtful company culture, including birthday recognitions and team appreciation initiatives.

Working Hours

  • Full-time role, 8 hours per day (excluding a 1-hour break).Â 
  • Schedule details may be discussed during the final stages of the hiring process.Â 
  • Scheduling is flexible; however, team members are required to maintain a minimum of 5â6 hours of overlap with the firm's operating hours in Pacific Time (PT), subject to operational needs and team coordination.

Application Process

Candidates may be asked to complete the following during the recruitment process:

  • Most recent Resume/CV (required).
  • Communication and presentation assessment, including a practical assignment relevant to HR operations, recruitment, or training material creation.
  • Proof of qualifications and professional references. To ensure fairness and accuracy, compensation verification may be conducted for shortlisted candidates.

Additional Information

  • This is a fully remote, South Africa-based role.
  • Engagement is as an independent contractor; tax compliance is the contractor's responsibility.
  • A 3-month probationary period will apply to support onboarding and performance alignment.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, contacting our offices by phone, email, or social media regarding this position is strictly prohibited. Any inquiries about application status through these channels will result in automatic disqualification from the hiring process. Our hiring team carefully reviews every submission and will contact qualified candidates directly.

title: Senior People & Talent Operations Partner
description:
â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â 

ð Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page. For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager.

Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â  Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

  • Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

  • Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

  • Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

  • Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

  • Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

  • Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

  • Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

  • Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

  • Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

  • Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

  • Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

  • Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

  • Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

  • Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

  • Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

  • HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

  • Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

  • Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

  • Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

  • Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
    *Check out the countries we currently hire from here.

  • Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

  • Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

  • Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

  • Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites.   • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.

  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

In This Role, You Will

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

Who You Are

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

    • Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts.

    • Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform:  datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other.

    • Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence.

  • Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification

    • Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber.

    • Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations.

  • Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards

    • Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on.

Strong automotive profiles willing to extend into the military world are very welcome.

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction:

Ready to build the platform behind Europe's smartest parking? At Peter Park, we replace barriers and paper tickets with computer vision and cloud software, across 90,000+ parking spaces in four countries.
As our (Senior) DevOps Engineer, you'll own the AWS and Kubernetes platform that keeps it all running: automating everything worth automating, and making sure it scales reliably as the traffic grows.


Your Objectives & Role:

  • Work on an amazing product with b2b and b2c aspects at the intersection of mobility and property technology
  • Shape the architecture of our cloud and microservice platform. You'll help decide how we run on AWS and Kubernetes, and how our services are built, connected and secured, all codified in Terraform.
  • Build the developer experience you always wished you had. Our frontend, backend and IoT teams should get a platform with self-service, fast feedback and golden paths, so shipping feels effortless and the infrastructure stays out of their way.
  • Automate DevOps with AI agents. We already use AI agents for investigations, reviews and routine ops work. You'll help us push further and design the guardrails that make it safe.
  • Make CI/CD fast and boring in the best way. You'll keep evolving our GitLab pipelines for backend and IoT deployments, so we can deploy to production continuously and with confidence.
  • Turn observability into a superpower. You'll improve how we monitor our services with Datadog, so we spot issues before customers do and every alert is worth waking up for.
  • Scale for thousands of parking lots and beyond. You'll make sure our systems keep up as the network grows, with reliability, cost and performance in mind.
  • Shape our engineering culture. You'll champion modern practices: clean, well-tested and efficient code, infrastructure as code, and blameless learning.


Your Expertise, Skills & Mindset:

  • Experienced DevOps Engineer: Not defined by years of experience but striving for continuous improvement, direct impact on the business, and ownership
  • Cloud & Kubernetes: You have deep hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes (ideally EKS) in production, including GitOps and CI/CD.
  • Reliability: You know observability, meaningful alerting, and incident response, and you build with security by default.
  • Coding & AI: You write automation in Python or TypeScript and use agentic AI tools every day.
  • Nice to have: Experience with IoT/edge deployments or running databases at scale.
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills (level C1). German language proficiency is not required


Technologies We Work With:

  • Cloud: AWS, with multi-account, multi-AZ networking, provisioned with Terraform in a modular, stack-based setup
  • Orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS) with Karpenter autoscaling, Envoy Gateway for ingress, KEDA for event-driven scaling and Helm for packaging
  • Delivery: GitOps and progressive delivery with Argo CD and Argo Rollouts, GitLab CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend and IoT deployments
  • Observability: Datadog for metrics, logs, APM and alerting across the whole stack
  • Serverless: AWS Lambda with the Serverless Framework for high-throughput endpoints
  • Data: Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElastiCache Redis, S3, plus Redshift for analytics
  • AI tooling:  Claude Code, MCP- and agentic based tooling that automate day-to-day ops work
  • What you'll be building for: event-driven microservices in TypeScript/NestJS (BullMQ, Prisma) and Python, and a Vue.js frontend monorepo (Turbo, pnpm, changesets, Storybook)


Work Setup:

  • Hours: 40 hours per week (based on trust).
  • Home Office Policy: Enjoy a hybrid model with 3 days in the office / 2 days remote.

title: Remote Maintenance Engineer

description:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and German skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: KYC/AML Associate (all genders)
description:

Als KYC/AML Associate sorgst du dafür, dass wir nur Mandate annehmen und fortführen, die geldwäscherechtlich einwandfrei sind. Damit bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mandatsannahme, Berufsrecht und Technologie. Deine Aufgaben

  • Geldwäscherechtliche Prüfung bei Mandatsannahme: Identifizierung, Ermittlung der wirtschaftlich Berechtigten inkl. Abgleich mit dem Transparenzregister, PEP- und Sanktionsscreening, Risikoeinstufung und Dokumentation nach GwG und unseren Arbeitsanweisungen

  • Offenheit für neue Tools: Du lernst schnell und siehst Technologie als Hebel

  • Selbstreflexion: Du kennst deine Stärken, erkennst Lücken und arbeitest daran, dich und dein Team weiterzubringen

title: Softwarearchitekt (x) Energiemarkt
description:
Über Greenflash

Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst.
Wir gestalten die Energieversorgung der Industrie von morgen. Das erfordert Menschen mit Ambitionen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und einen spürbaren Beitrag leisten wollen.

Wir vertrauen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.
Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben.

Wir wachsen gemeinsam.
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld.


Deine Mission

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur.
  • Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen.
  • Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein.
  • Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse.
  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
  • Ein Team mit Ambition
    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
  • Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise
    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.
  • Erfolge gemeinsam erleben
    Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

title: Creative Director Digital (on site - Hamburg)
description:
OKTOPODS turns brand clarity into connected experiences that drive measurable growth.

OKTOPODS is a brand-led transformation partner for companies whose brand, marketing and digital experience need to work as one. Our three hearts—OKTObrand, OKTOtech and OKTOcreative—connect brand strategy, digital experiences and creative communication.

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong ideas, sharp narrative thinking, excellent craft and the ability to lead people.

You’ll lead a focused creative team, combining human creativity and judgment with the speed and possibilities of AI. You’ll own creative direction and quality, guide the narrative, and help the team turn business challenges into compelling solutions.

You stay actively involved in concepts, storytelling and design. You also know how to use available AI tools and internal systems to explore ideas, visualise directions, prototype experiences and accelerate execution. Throughout that process, you keep the work strategically clear, coherent and distinctive.

You’ll lead creative pitches, advise clients and share responsibility for growth and successful delivery.

Aufgaben

  • Develop strong creative ideas. Translate brand positioning, business objectives and client briefs into distinctive concepts, narratives, campaigns and digital experiences.
  • Own the narrative and creative direction. Define what the work should communicate, how it should feel and what it should achieve. Carry that direction consistently from the first idea to final delivery.
  • Stay close to the craft. Contribute directly to key concepts, presentations, storytelling and design decisions, helping the team strengthen and finish the work.
  • Use AI confidently throughout the creative process. Work with existing online tools and internal systems for research, exploration, visualisation, prototyping and production. Choose the right approach for the task.
  • Guide and refine AI output. Provide clear briefs, context and references; judge the results; and steer iterations toward the intended solution. Combine generated material with human refinement to meet the creative standard.
  • Lead and develop a team of three. Establish clear ownership, give useful feedback and coach people. Help the team combine creative skill, practical AI use and efficient collaboration.
  • Set and uphold quality standards. Lead creative reviews and take responsibility for the relevance, originality, consistency and execution of the work.
  • Connect brand, experience and communication. Collaborate across strategy, design, content and technology so the brand promise carries through every touchpoint.
  • Lead creative pitches and client conversations. Develop persuasive recommendations, present ideas clearly, handle feedback and build confidence in the work.
  • Share responsibility for growth and delivery. Develop relevant client opportunities with client service, agree realistic scope and timing with project leads, and make informed decisions about effort, budget and quality.
  • Make our work visible. Help turn projects into compelling cases that explain the challenge, creative contribution and results.

Qualifikation

  • Substantial experience in creative direction, brand and digital work, including team leadership.
  • Strong conceptual and narrative skills, supported by a portfolio of distinctive ideas and excellent execution.
  • Hands-on strength in your creative discipline and sound judgment across design, storytelling, motion and interactive experiences.
  • Practical experience using AI tools within real creative projects, with the ability to brief, evaluate and refine their output.
  • Good understanding of digital experiences and development workflows, enabling confident collaboration with technical colleagues.
  • Experience leading pitches, advising clients and connecting creative recommendations to business objectives.
  • Clear leadership, constructive feedback and the ability to develop a small team.
  • Native German for client conversations, selling ideas and pitches, and very strong English for international collaboration.

Benefits

  • An international team, ambitious projects and global clients.
  • Real influence over creative direction, team development and agency growth.
  • A focused team combining creative expertise, AI speed and human control.
  • Competitive senior-level compensation, with performance incentives linked to agreed goals.
  • Training, conferences, creative tools and leadership development.
  • Short decision paths, skilled colleagues and a dog-friendly Hamburg office.
  • A permanent contract and 30 days of annual leave.

We’re not hiring for a seat-filler.

We’re hiring a storm.

Someone who can see around corners, turn ideas into action, and chaos into clarity.

Show us work with a clear idea, strong craft and a meaningful result. Tell us what you created, what you led and how you brought the work to life—including how you used AI within your creative process.

Standort: Dresden | Voll- oder Teilzeit | Unbefristet

Für unseren Mandanten, eine mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft mit Standorten in Dresden, Chemnitz und München, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Teamleiter Jahresabschluss / Steuerberater (m/w/d) am Standort Dresden. Als Teil einer interdisziplinär aufgestellten Beratergruppe begleitet das Unternehmen Unternehmen, Unternehmerfamilien und Privatpersonen in steuerlichen, betriebswirtschaftlichen und prüfungsnahen Fragestellungen. Die Position verbindet fachliche Verantwortung in der Jahresabschlusserstellung mit der Führung und Entwicklung eines eigenen Teams und bietet damit erfahrenen Steuerberatern die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Karriereschritt in Richtung Führung zu gehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Teamleitung: Fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für ein Teilteam von rund 10 Mitarbeitenden innerhalb eines insgesamt etwa 40-köpfigen Teams – mit dem Ziel, eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit und effiziente Abläufe sicherzustellen

  • Jahresabschlüsse & Steuererklärungen: Referenzierung und fachliche Beurteilung von Jahresabschlüssen sowie betrieblichen Steuererklärungen für Mandanten unterschiedlicher Rechtsformen

  • Fachliche Verantwortung: Einordnung komplexer handels- und steuerrechtlicher Sachverhalte sowie Begleitung fachlicher Stellungnahmen und anspruchsvoller Fragestellungen

  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung einheitlicher fachlicher Qualitätsstandards innerhalb des Teams und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse

  • Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Fachliche Begleitung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden – Wissen vermitteln, Feedback geben und individuelle Entwicklung gezielt unterstützen

  • Führungsverantwortung: Aktive Mitgestaltung der Zusammenarbeit im Bereich Jahresabschluss und Übernahme einer zentralen Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Mitarbeitenden und übergeordneter Leitung

Ihr Profil

  • Fachliche Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgelegtes Steuerberaterexamen als Grundlage für die fachliche Verantwortung innerhalb des Teams

  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Steuerberatung mit fundierter Praxis rund um Jahresabschlüsse, betriebliche Steuererklärungen sowie handels- und steuerrechtliche Fragestellungen

  • Führungskompetenz: Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder disziplinarischen Führung von Mitarbeitenden – alternativ die klare Motivation, sich gezielt in eine Führungsrolle weiterzuentwickeln

  • Fachliche Sicherheit: Fundierte handels- und steuerrechtliche Kenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte sicher zu beurteilen und verständlich innerhalb des Teams zu vermitteln

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständig, strukturiert und unternehmerisch denkend – verbunden mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch und einem sicheren Blick für Prioritäten

  • Persönlichkeit: Kommunikationsstarke und wertschätzende Führungspersönlichkeit mit Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Mitarbeitende weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen

  • Softwarekenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV und MS Office sowie Offenheit gegenüber digitalen Prozessen und modernen Arbeitsweisen

Ihre Vorteile

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Arbeitszeitkonto, bis zu 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sowie 30 Urlaubstage

  • Finanzielle Zusatzleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, 80 % Zuschuss zum Jobticket bzw. Deutschlandticket sowie wahlweise Konsumkarte oder EGYM Wellpass

  • Führungsperspektive: Verantwortungsvolle Position mit eigenem Teilteam und der Möglichkeit, die fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung von rund 10 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Entwicklung: Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie bezahlte Weiterbildungen, Qualifizierungen und Schulungen zur gezielten fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Gesundheit: Gesundheitstag, regenerative Pausen und Lauftraining, Zuschüsse zu Massageangeboten sowie Teilnahme an gemeinsamen Lauf-, Wander- und Volleyballveranstaltungen

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Computertechnik und professionelle IT-Infrastruktur mit direktem Support durch einen hauseigenen IT-Service

  • Verpflegung: Kostenfreies Wasser, Kaffee und Tee sowie regionales und vom Arbeitgeber bezuschusstes Mittagessen

  • Unternehmenskultur: Kollegiale und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit innerhalb einer etablierten Beratergruppe – geprägt von fachlichem Austausch, persönlicher Wertschätzung und regelmäßigen Firmenfeiern und Teamevents

Unsolicited Application (all genders)

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen or Lisbon · Various employment types · Open year round

None of the open positions fits your skillset or passion?

We're hiring across various roles, and this is where you come in anyway. Not every great fit shows up exactly when we happen to have an open position, if you think you'd be a good match for Thorit but none of our current postings quite fit your profile, we still want to hear from you.

We're the AI and CRM consultancy for the agent native enterprise. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner, we work with B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it together with our clients. Agentic means software that works toward goals instead of waiting for clicks, that's the shift we help our clients make, and it's also how we try to run things internally, in sales, delivery, and People & Culture.

What we're always interested in

We continuously look for people with experience in the following areas, even outside of specific open roles:

  • HubSpot implementation, CRM architecture, and Marketing/Sales/Service Hub expertise

  • AI agent development, automation, and agentic workflows

  • Consulting, project leadership, and technical delivery in a B2B environment

  • Sales and business development in the DACH market

  • Finance, People & Culture, and internal operations

If your background is in a different area and you still think you'd be a good fit, reach out anyway.

What You Should Bring

  • A sense of ownership, and an interest in shaping processes and structures rather than just executing them

  • Experience that fits a growing, agentic consultancy, whether from consulting, a software company, or another industry

  • Working proficiency in German and English

What Happens Next

We review open applications regularly, however in case of an open application, it can take some time. Please be patient with us! If your profile matches a current or upcoming role, we'll reach out for an initial conversation.

What We Offer

  • Pension & Allowances: Company pension scheme via Allianz with graduated employer contribution from €50 to €290 per month, plus Lunchit meal allowance worth up to €100 per month

  • Health & Mobility: Business Bike Leasing, Urban Sports Club access at 8,000+ locations

  • Flexibility: Up to 4 weeks per year working from anywhere in the EU with a €500 allowance, Spaces co-working membership, hybrid setup

Ready to Apply?

Send us your CV and a few lines on why Thorit interests you. You don't need a formal cover letter, but we'd love a short note on which area you see yourself in and what draws you to an agentic consultancy.
