title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 

About our Team

AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
 

About our Engineering Department

The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.
 
Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.
 
Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.

The role

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners.

A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it.

As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them.


Responsibilities
  • Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow.
  • Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources.
  • Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible.
  • Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution.
  • Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration.
  • Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor.

    • Qualifications
  • Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count. 
  • Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar.
  • Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key.
  • Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt).
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS).
  • Any STEM degree or equivalent experience.

    • Nice-to-have
  • Experience with AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage.
  • Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry).
  • Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions.
  • Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity.

    • Our recruitment process
    1. First discussion with our Talent Acquisition
    2. Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager
    3. Technical assessment of your skills in a deep-dive interview with the team
    4. VP interview to share wider team vision and align motivations
    5. Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO, Emmanuelle
    6. Final interview with our co-founder and CEO, Maximillien

    Why Join Us? 

    At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.
    Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline : Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal.
    World-Class Interdisciplinary Team : work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation.
    DeepTech Recognition: AQEMIA is proud to be part of the French Tech 40 and France 2030, highlighting our role as a key player in Europe’s DeepTech ecosystem.
    Prime Location with Flexibility : Our offices are located in the heart of Paris and London (King’s Cross), with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week.
    Strong Financial Backing : $100M raised from leading European and International investors

About the Drug Discovery Team

The Drug Discovery Sciences team (~20 people) combines expertise in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, biology, and translational science .

Working at the intersection of AI-driven drug design, molecular simulations, and experimental science, the team is responsible for driving scientific excellence across Aqemia’s drug discovery programs and delivering clinical candidates.

They develop and apply innovative methodologies ensuring that scientific insights translate into high-quality therapeutic opportunities.

Partnering closely with Platform, Engineering, and Program teams, they play a critical role in advancing novel small-molecule therapeutics from concept to clinical candidate.


 

The role

Join Aqemia in a role where you will help shape our rapidly expanding portfolio of small molecule programs across diverse therapeutic areas, beginning with oncology and immuno-oncology. This is a unique chance to build a pipeline working closely with the VP of biology, and multidisciplinary teams to accelerate the discovery of clinical candidates. You’ll become part of a dedicated team focusing on providing biological support across the Aqemia portfolio.


Responsibilities
  • Drive the identification, validation, and selection of novel biological targets aligned with clear unmet medical needs
  • Contribute to early-stage project ideation by providing deep biological insight and a strong understanding of the drug discovery value chain
  • Guide programs from early discovery into the AQEMIA pipeline, supporting progression toward proof of concept
  • Design, implement, and maintain screening cascades to enable efficient compound evaluation and decision-making
  • Partner with project teams to provide biological expertise, identify risks, and support data-driven prioritization
  • Manage and collaborate with external CROs to define experimental strategies and ensure generation of high-quality, decision-enabling datasets
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration, integrating biology with chemistry, modeling, and platform teams

    • Qualifications
  • PhD in biological sciences (e.g., pharmacology, molecular biology, chemical biology, biochemistry) or equivalent industry experience

title: GenAI Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.
  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.
  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.
  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...
  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos de la mission

En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients.

Architecture & Ingénierie GenAI

Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production :

  • Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching, system prompts) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct).

  • Industrialisation & FinOps : Évaluation de la fiabilité (LLM-as-a-judge), maîtrise des coûts au token, guardrails de sécurité (AI Act, prompt injection, étanchéité des données) et déploiement multi-cloud (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI).

Formation & Transmission "Développeur Augmenté" (SFEIR Institute)

Tu es le visage de l'excellence pédagogique de SFEIR. Tu conçois et animes nos parcours phares (jusqu'à 60% de pratique / labs) pour transformer les méthodes de dev chez nos clients :

  • Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté (Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI.

  • Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte (CLAUDE.md, règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés.

  • Pédagogie & Regard Critique : Vulgarisation adaptative (du décideur à l'ingénieur) tout en insufflant une culture de la sécurité (code review, vulnérabilités) et du maintien des compétences en dev classique.

Conseil & Stratégie GenAI

Tu transformes des besoins métiers complexes ou flous en feuilles de route opérationnelles et à fort ROI :

  • Cadrage & Roadmap : Animation d'ateliers d'idéation, priorisation des cas d'usage (Quick Wins vs Chantiers structurants) et construction du business case pour les sponsors.

  • Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy, conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token.

  • Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement.

▪️ Le profil idéal

Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) ou bénéficiant d'une solide expérience terrain équivalente dans la conception logicielle et l'architecture système.

Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle ou architecture cloud, avec une spécialisation marquée et récente en IA générative, ingénierie de prompt et orchestration agentique. Une première expérience réussie en formation/consulting ou une appétence forte pour la transmission est indispensable.

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, Python, GenAI) avec trois Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

title: Développeur C# / .Net (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA
  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique
  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network
  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...
  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos de la mission

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Développeur .Net/C# (F/H/NB).

Tes missions au quotidien :

  • Back-end : Maîtrise avancée de C# / .NET 8+, architectures Microservices et APIs sécurisées
  • Data & Messaging : Gestion de la donnée sous toutes ses formes avec SQL Server, MongoDB et architectures orientées événements via Kafka
  • Cloud & Industrialisation : Déploiement sur environnements Cloud Public (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Craftsmanship : Le Clean Code, le TDD et les revues de code sont tes standards de livraison, pas des options

▪️ Le profil idéal

Formation & Parcours : Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur, Master) ou équivalent.

Expérience : 5 ans minimum comme Développeur .NET (idéalement sur de forts volumes de données), avec une maîtrise de :

  • .NET Core 8, Microservices, DDD, REST & Design First.

  • Databases & Messaging : SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ.

  • DevOps & Cloud : DevOps (CI/CD), Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana.

  • Outillage : Git, JIRA.

Soft Skills : Esprit d'équipe, autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'initiative et curiosité technique.

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, C# et .Net) avec trois Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

title: Data Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA
  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique
  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network
  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...
  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches répétitives et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos de la mission

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Data Engineer confirmé (F/H/NB). Au cœur de nos projets clients les plus ambitieux, ton objectif principal sera de donner de la valeur à la donnée et d'imaginer des architectures de pointe, prêtes pour l'IA (AI-Ready).

Au quotidien, tu seras le moteur technique de la structuration des données chez nos clients :

  • Architecturer des pipelines data robustes avec Python, SQL, dbt et Airflow
  • Travailler avec BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka ou les outils MLOps
  • Penser Data Quality, gouvernance, observabilité et optimisation des coûts
  • Construire des plateformes de données fiables et évolutives 
  • Participer à l’industrialisation des usages IA
  • Transformer des datasets complexes en produits data exploitables
  • Expérimenter les nouveaux usages de l’IA appliqués à la Data

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (Master, école d'ingénieur) ou un parcours équivalent avec une solide expérience acquise sur le terrain.
  • Expérience : Tu justifies de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience réussie sur un rôle similaire de Data Engineer, idealement dans des environnements exigeants.
  • Stack & Méthode : Tu maîtrises l'écosystème Cloud et Big Data, tu aimes appliquer les bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle (CI/CD, tests, code clean) et tu as envie de transmettre ton savoir-faire au sein du collectif.

▪️ L'ancrage Toulousain 

L'agence SFEIR Toulouse regroupe une équipe à taille humaine de plus de 10 expert·e·s de haut niveau. Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, Python, SQL) avec trois Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Toulouse
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional.

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and French skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Quality & Training Manager
description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

To support our continued growth, we are creating a new, strategic role at the heart of operational performance and customer experience. There is no Quality & Training activity in the Group today : you will build it from the ground up.

 

Your role

As Quality & Training Manager, you will create and lead the Quality & Training activity for the whole HousingAnywhere Group, covering the Operations teams in Cergy and Rotterdam. You define its scope, methods and tools, and you are responsible for service quality and operational practices across the Group.

You work closely with the managers of the Customer Support and Booking Ops teams to structure training, onboarding, quality monitoring and performance tooling.

The role is based in France, with frequent travel to our Rotterdam office. English is the main working language.

Building the Quality & Training activity

  • Design the Quality & Training activity : scope, operating model, priorities and roadmap,
  • Set up the tools, rituals and governance needed to run the activity at Group level,
  • Harmonise quality and training practices between the Cergy and Rotterdam teams,
  • Lay the foundations for the activity to grow as needs evolve.

Training & onboarding

  • Identify the training needs of the Ops teams, and accompany the integration process while migrating to a single operating model in 2027,
  • Develop complete training programmes covering customer service posture, tools, and day-to-day processes and procedures,
  • Create and maintain training materials (scripts, practical guides, process sheets, e-learning content), working with the other departments like Product for new features,
  • Run a structured onboarding and support new joiners in live situations after initial training, to bridge theory and practice,
  • Carry out an individual assessment at the end of onboarding (audits, call listening, double listening, tests) and provide personalised follow-up,
  • Lead group and one-to-one sessions, on-the-spot debriefs and targeted coaching on the fundamentals: call handling, request qualification, rephrasing, quality of written and spoken answers, and CRM data entry,
  • Train teams on new procedures and tool changes as they are rolled out.

Quality & operational performance

  • Define and roll out quality standards and control frameworks for each team, across the full user journey,
  • Build structured quality reporting by individual, team and business unit, with a monthly report to managers,
  • Analyse interactions, indicators and recurring errors to identify root causes and drive continuous improvement plans,

Knowledge management

  • Collaborate with the Ops Project Manager to maintain the knowledge base,
  • Build a culture of knowledge sharing and self-learning (e-learning) to reduce reliance on informal mentoring.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Contribute to Voice of Customer and customer satisfaction projects by sharing pain points identified through quality monitoring,
  • Propose initiatives to align operational practices with company strategy and the user experience.
  • Advise and support managers on using tools and analysing performance.

 

Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in training, quality management or quality monitoring of customer service or operations teams.
  • Experience building a quality or training activity from scratch, or a strong drive to do so,
  • Experience setting up a quality monitoring programme (call listening, audits, calibration),
  • Solid knowledge of customer service best practices and operational process management,
  • Ability to analyse spoken and written interactions and turn them into concrete recommendations,
  • Teaching skills, structure and a results focus, with the ability to convince and motivate teams,
  • Comfortable with CRM and telephony tools, e-learning content creation and performance dashboards,
  • Fluent English and French are required. English is the main working language,
  • Willingness to travel frequently to Rotterdam.

 

Why this opportunity?

  • A newly created role: you build the Group's Quality & Training activity from the ground up.
  • Group-wide impact across our teams in Cergy and Rotterdam.
  • A high level of autonomy to design tools, processes and training materials.
  • An international environment, working between France and the Netherlands.
  • A role combining training, quality and operations, both strategic and hands-on.

 

What's in it for you

  • Position based in our Cergy office.
  • Executive status with 218 workdays/year (with RTT days off).
  • 50% transport costs covered.
  • 70% health insurance coverage.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Contribution to fitness membership costs.
  • Christmas gift vouchers.
  • Team-building events and much more!

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

  • Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

  • Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

description:
Unsere Standorte

Wir suchen dich für unser Vertriebsteam in der Schweiz an unserem Standort in Liebefeld bei Bern


Dein zukünftiges Team

Bei Meierhofer treiben wir die Digitalisierung von Spitälern, Reha und psychiatrischen Kliniken voran. Mit unseren Softwarelösungen für Klinikprozesse, Patientenmanagement und digitale, versorgungsübergreifende Workflows gestalten wir die Patientenversorgung effizienter und sicherer. Als Sales Manager verbindest du Neukundengewinnung mit strategischer Account-Entwicklung und baust unsere Marktposition im Schweizer Healthcare-IT-Markt weiter aus. Dich erwarten komplexe Sales Cycles, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Healthcare-IT-Expert*innen.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Du gewinnst neue Spitäler und steuerst den Sales Cycle bis zum Abschluss
  • Du entwickelst Accounts weiter und hebst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale
  • Du gewinnst Entscheider*innen in Management, IT und Fachbereichen
  • Du steuerst Ausschreibungen, Offerten und Vertragsverhandlungen mit unseren Fachteams
  • Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen überzeugend auf Management- und C-Level
  • Du verfolgst Markttrends, pflegst dein Netzwerk und vertrittst Meierhofer auf Branchenevents


Das sind deine Stärken & Skills

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Software oder SaaS, idealerweise für Softwarelösungen für Kliniken
  • Du hast nachweislich Neukunden gewonnen und komplexe Sales Cycles abgeschlossen
  • Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und den Vertrieb in regulierten Märkten
  • Du bist versiert in Ausschreibungen, Offerten und Verhandlungen mit mehreren Stakeholdern
  • Du kommunizierst und präsentierst sicher auf Management- und C-Level

We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

description:
Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich

This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

  • Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on

  • Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology

  • Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack

  • Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality

  • Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team

What you'll bring

  • MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

  • Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

  • Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

  • 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team

Nice to have

  • A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

  • Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course

  • Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record

What We Offer:

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

title: Legal Operations Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We’re looking for a leader to own our legal operations function and continue building it for our next phase of growth. Working with a dedicated automations engineering team, you will own the systems that ensure the Legal Team scales with the company: contract management, vendor relationships (including outside counsel billing and guidelines) and the overall legal tech stack. The goal is simple: help define what a legal organization looks like in the AI native era.

In this role, you will:

  • Assist in the design and improvement of the operating model for Legal. Identify work that should be handled by the team and areas where we can continue automating.

  • Manage our legal technology stack, including contract lifecycle management (Ironclad), matter management, and creating an e-billing systems

  • Manage relationships with outside counsel and legal service providers, including budget and performance tracking

  • Work with our automation teams to use Eleven Agents and other tools to change the way work is done across the team

  • Define metrics and build dashboards that give us a clear view of the team's priorities, workload and performance

  • Partner with Finance, IT, FDE and business teams to keep legal processes aligned with how the company operates

Who you are:

  • You are a strategist and an operator. You are incredibly intellectually curious and enjoy breaking down and rebuilding processes

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive - you’re comfortable juggling multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy

  • Genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies.

  • A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams

  • Comfortable working independently in a distributed, high-trust environment

  • You have previous experience at a high-growth technology or AI company

What you bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in legal operations with some experience leading the function

  • Deep expertise in legal technology, including CLM platforms (Ironclad a major plus), e-billing systems, and matter management tools

  • Experience supporting global teams

  • Strong analytical skills with experience gathering metrics to storytell and drive key business decisions

  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed anywhere in the United States.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Compensation: $80K – $130K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - NA
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth.

As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises.

  • Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate.

  • Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model.

  • Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way.

Must Haves:

  • Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity.

  • Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting.

  • Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes.

  • Experience implementing IAM federation.

  • Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications.

  • Experience with L3 support/incident management.

Suchst Du eine neue Herausforderung und möchtest Dein Know-how im Ersatzteilwesen einbringen? Dann könnte diese Stelle zu Dir passen! Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung sucht Daimler Buses für den wachsenden Standort in Granges-Paccot einen Teamleiter Ersatzteile.
